phase_name: Milestone v1.1 — ELM Training & Distillation Pipeline (gnus-poc)

human_actions_pending.context: Required for Phase 2+ API features. Key already formatted correctly. Get from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys

decisions.decision: DeepSeek v4 pro as teacher model
decisions.rationale: MIT license, explicit distillation permission. API-driven (no local GPU cluster needed)

decisions.decision: FP4 Ultra v0.2 spec for binary export
decisions.rationale: 64x64 macroblocks, fixed 2048-byte payload, FP4_AFFINE + T158_AFFINE modes
Low enough to prevent cost accidents, high enough for initial synthetic data generation
Cuts memory ~75% for 30B-A3B models on 64GB Macs
Qwen3-Coder has different chat template than Qwen3-Instruct — must use correct tokenizer per specialist

next_action: Fix 3 HIGH integration gaps from milestone review: (1) wire TrainingConfig into train_specialists_mlx.py, (2) integrate distillation loss into MLX-LM training loop, (3) make PipelineRunner actually execute stages
context_notes: Milestone v1.1 is complete as a POC — 7 well-structured, well-tested modules. The 3 HIGH concerns are integration gaps, not bugs: modules work individually but aren't connected end-to-end. TrainingConfig/dedup/memory-estimator exist but train_specialists_mlx.py still uses old OVERRIDES dict. Distiller computes loss but MLX-LM doesn't support custom loss functions. PipelineRunner prints commands instead of executing them. These are the natural next priorities.
